topic.title: Types of Review Tasks
topic.shortdesc: supports two types of review tasks: Project Review Tasks and Independent Review Tasks.

body.p: Project Review Tasks and Independent Review Tasks are designed for different review scenarios. The following information describes the main differences between them.

row.entry: Project members, task owners, and invited reviewers
Integration into the project is part of the task workflow

section.title: Project Review Tasks
section.p: Project Review Tasks are created from content in projects. They belong to a project, and task owners can integrate accepted changes back into the project at the end of the review process as part of the project review task workflow.

Only users with the Author platform user role can create Project Review Tasks. All project members can see the review tasks created in that project. In addition, the task owner and any invited reviewers can see and access the task.
Use this type of task when the content is already managed in a project.

section.title: Independent Review Tasks
section.p: Independent Review Tasks are not tied to a project. They are useful when the content being reviewed is outside a project or when you start the review from a supported desktop tool.

Users with the Author platform user role and users with the Subject-Matter Expert platform user role can create Independent Review Tasks. Only the task owner and invited reviewers can see and access the task.
Any follow-up integration is handled outside the review task workflow.

Independent Review Tasks can be created from or from Oxygen XML desktop tools. To create them from , see . To create them from Oxygen XML desktop tools, install the Oxygen Content Fusion Connector add-on. It integrates with Oxygen XML Editor and Oxygen XML Author. For more information, see the Oxygen Content Fusion Connector Add-on Documentation.
